referenceFidelity.findings: Original woodland shelter matches the muted forest palette. Broad asymmetrical rock volume, mossy roof and large dark entrance are readable in front and isometric views.

construction.findings: Connected rim, recessed tunnel and rear shell inspected from front, side and reverse. The mouth has real depth; the rear is closed. Ground contacts and fitted shoulder rocks have no visible gaps. Source audit found zero non-manifold edges or zero-area faces.

readability.findings: Entrance reads clearly at campus desktop scale, at the end of the promenade with trees clear of its mouth. At full-campus phone framing the model is small; zoom is available for detail.

motion.findings: Static asset; no motion clips in the contract.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked the front opening against the oblique and rear views: the lip is continuous, roof planes meet cleanly and the dark back wall sits behind the entrance. Placement keeps the cave inside its reserved woodland clearing.

userAcceptance.note: Awaiting user artistic review of this revision.

limitations: Static environmental artwork; no gameplay interactions.
